title: elytrigia pungens subsp. fontqueri
intro: Elytrigia pungens subsp. fontqueri, commonly known as Sea Fennel, is a subspecies of the Elytrigia pungens plant, a type of grass that belongs to the wheat family (Poaceae). The plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the Mediterranean region, due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sea Fennel include soothing and calming effects on the digestive system, as well as its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Elytrigia pungens subsp. fontqueri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
